Tale of Two Teams: Excellent Doctors Let Down by Reception at Moatfield Surgery
Moatfield Surgery clearly houses some truly dedicated and skilled medical professionals. My experiences with the doctors themselves have been overwhelmingly positive. They consistently demonstrated genuine care, respect, and a level of professionalism that is truly commendable. However, a significant drawback overshadows the excellent medical care offered: the inconsistent and often frustrating experiences with the reception team.

It’s a shame to say that the front-of-house experience at Moatfield Surgery feels like a hurdle rather than a helpful gateway to much-needed healthcare. I’ve noticed a high turnover rate among the reception staff and management. This constant flux seemingly contributes to a lack of experience and training that is readily apparent in their interactions.

Basic customer service skills, a cornerstone of any patient-facing role, appear to be frequently absent. This manifests in various ways, from abrupt phone manner to a general lack of empathy and helpfulness when navigating appointments and inquiries. This isn’t just a matter of politeness; it creates tangible barriers to accessing the care patients desperately need.

Imagine feeling unwell and needing to schedule an appointment, only to be met with indifference or, worse, unhelpful resistance. It's incredibly disheartening and ultimately undermines the hard work of the doctors within.

The reception staff's handling of complaints also leaves much to be desired. Instead of calming tensions and finding solutions, interactions often felt dismissive and unproductive. A skilled reception team in a healthcare setting should be equipped to handle complaints calmly and professionally, ensuring patients feel heard, understood, and supported. Unfortunately, the current team falls far short of these expectations. They lack the communication skills and emotional intelligence needed to de-escalate potentially stressful situations.

Adding to the frustration is the apparent lack of a readily available and clear complaints procedure. The surgery's website offers no easily accessible information on how to officially lodge a complaint, further compounding the feeling that patient concerns are not prioritized. Directing individuals to complain in this way is an obstacle for anyone who wants to make a remark.

Ultimately, the disparity between the excellent standard of medical care provided by the doctors and the subpar service offered by the reception team became too significant to ignore. The unnecessary stress and frustration caused by repeated negative interactions with the front desk led me to the difficult decision to leave Moatfield Surgery and register with another practice.

Moatfield Surgery has the potential to be a truly outstanding healthcare provider. However, they urgently need to address the issues within their reception team, investing in comprehensive training and hiring experienced individuals who understand the importance of providing compassionate and efficient service. Only then can they truly complement the dedication and expertise of their medical staff and provide patients with the seamless and supportive healthcare experience they deserve.",null,[0,155]]]],[null,1748515076000000,1748515076000000,"9 months ago",null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/13802647613665042574/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZOVUdKc1NtMXVOalYxZEhSM1JSQUIQAA%3D%3D",[null,null,null,"/local/business/13802647613665042574/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZOVUdKc1NtMXVOalYxZEhSM1JSQUIQAA%3D%3D"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/13802647613665042574/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZOVUdKc1NtMXVOalYxZEhSM1JSQUIQAA%3D%3D",[null,null,null,"/local/business/13802647613665042574/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZOVUdKc1NtMXVOalYxZEhSM1JSQUIQAA%3D%3D"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/13802647613665042574/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZOVUdKc1NtMXVOalYxZEhSM1JSQUIQAA%3D%3D",[null,null,null,"/local/business/13802647613665042574/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiRDaGREU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZOVUdKc1NtMXVOalYxZEhSM1JSQUIQAA%3D%3D"],null,["en"],[["Dear Aaryan,
